title: Vibrant Italian Pasta Bake
description: A quick-fix Italian dish featuring garlicky and chewy pasta, cranberry, and render-fat, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian diet. This vibrant bake is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mince the garlic and saute it in olive oil until fragrant.
Combine cooked pasta, garlic, cranberry sauce, and rendered fat in a large bowl.
Mix well to combine, then stir in grated mozzarella, chopped basil, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mozzarella if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
